_comment: Fixture for scripts/import-erg.mjs --fixture. A small, hand-checked sample (not the full ERG 2024) so field-api-check.mjs and manual testing work without the PHMSA PDFs, which the owner must save into docs/uploaded files/erg/ themselves (their CDN blocks scripted downloads -- see the phase doc). Guide/distance text below is a short paraphrase for the prototype, not the verbatim ERG text; the real import (--pdf) should replace these rows with the actual guide sections and distance tables.

sections.potentialHazards: Extremely flammable; may form explosive mixtures with air; vapors from liquefied gas are heavier than air and spread along ground; may explode if ignited in an enclosed area.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. As an immediate precaution, isolate spill or leak area for at least 100 meters in all directions. Eliminate all ignition sources.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Do not extinguish a leaking gas fire unless leak can be stopped. Stop flow of gas if safe to do so. SPILL: Stop leak if safe to do so; ventilate area.

sections.potentialHazards: Toxic; may be fatal if inhaled or absorbed through skin; contact may cause burns to skin and eyes; runoff may pollute waterways.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill or leak area immediately for at least 100 meters in all directions; see the Table of Initial Isolation and Protective Action Distances for this guide.
sections.emergencyResponse: Move victims to fresh air; positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus and chemical protective clothing required. Do not touch or walk through spilled material.

sections.potentialHazards: Toxic; corrosive; contact with gas or liquefied gas may cause burns, severe injury and/or frostbite.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill or leak area immediately for at least 100 meters in all directions; see the Table of Initial Isolation and Protective Action Distances for this guide.
sections.emergencyResponse: Fully encapsulating, vapor-protective clothing should be worn; self-contained breathing apparatus should be used.

guides.title: Flammable Liquids (Water-Miscible / Polar / Non-Regulated for Marine Pollution)

sections.potentialHazards: Highly flammable; vapors may travel to an ignition source and flash back; container may explode in heat of fire.
sections.publicSafety: Keep unnecessary people away; isolate hazard area and deny entry. Stay upwind. Eliminate all ignition sources.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use dry chemical, CO2, water spray or alcohol-resistant foam. SPILL: Absorb with non-combustible material; prevent entry into waterways.

sections.potentialHazards: Highly flammable; vapor may explode if ignited in an enclosed area; vapors are heavier than air and may travel along the ground to an ignition source.
sections.publicSafety: Isolate spill or leak area for at least 50 meters in all directions for liquids and 25 meters for solids. Keep unauthorized personnel away; stay upwind; eliminate ignition sources.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use dry chemical, CO2, water spray or foam; do not use straight streams. SPILL: Absorb with sand or other non-combustible material; do not touch or walk through spilled material.

sections.potentialHazards: Highly flammable; may be irritating if inhaled at high concentrations; vapor may travel to an ignition source.
sections.publicSafety: Isolate spill area; keep unauthorized personnel away; stay upwind; eliminate ignition sources.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use alcohol-resistant foam, dry chemical, CO2 or water spray. SPILL: Dike far ahead of liquid spill; absorb with non-combustible material.

sections.potentialHazards: Flammable and toxic; vapors may cause dizziness or suffocation; contact may irritate or burn skin and eyes.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill area; positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus recommended.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use dry chemical, CO2, water spray or foam. SPILL: Do not touch or walk through spilled material; stop leak if safe to do so.

sections.potentialHazards: May ignite on contact with moist air or moisture; toxic fumes may form in a fire.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Keep material dry; isolate area; positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus recommended.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use water spray, wet sand or dry chemical as recommended for the specific material. SPILL: Small dry spills - with clean shovel place material into clean, dry container.

sections.potentialHazards: May ignite spontaneously on contact with air or moisture; produces toxic and/or corrosive fumes in a fire or on contact with water.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Keep material dry; isolate area for at least 25-50 meters.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Do NOT use water on the material itself. SPILL: Do not touch damaged containers or spilled material without protective clothing.

sections.potentialHazards: Contact with water releases toxic and corrosive fumes; may cause severe burns to skin, eyes and respiratory tract.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Keep material dry; isolate spill area for at least 50 meters.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Do NOT get water inside containers. SPILL: Fully encapsulating, vapor-protective clothing should be worn.

sections.potentialHazards: Toxic; may be fatal if inhaled, swallowed or absorbed through skin; corrosive to metals and tissue.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill area; positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus and chemical protective clothing recommended.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use water spray, fog, dry chemical, CO2 or foam. SPILL: Do not touch or walk through spilled material; stop leak if safe to do so.

sections.potentialHazards: Corrosive and/or toxic; contact causes severe burns to skin, eyes and respiratory tract; runoff may pollute waterways.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill area for at least 50 meters; chemical protective clothing recommended.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Small fires - dry chemical, CO2, water spray or foam. SPILL: Do not touch spilled material; stop leak if safe to do so; dike far ahead of spill.

sections.potentialHazards: Corrosive and a strong oxidizer; contact causes severe burns; may react violently with combustible/organic materials.
sections.publicSafety: CALL Emergency Response Telephone Number. Isolate spill area for at least 50 meters; chemical protective clothing recommended.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Flood fire area with water. SPILL: Fully encapsulating, vapor-protective clothing should be worn for spills with no fire.

sections.potentialHazards: May be toxic to aquatic life; runoff from fire control or dilution water may pollute waterways.
sections.publicSafety: Isolate spill area; keep out of waterways, sewers, basements or confined areas.
sections.emergencyResponse: FIRE: Use extinguishing agent suitable for surrounding fire. SPILL: Prevent entry into waterways, sewers, basements; contain and collect for later disposal.
